ha.title: House ads
ha.sub: Our own offers inside the journal: banners, products, combos and categories. Never an outside ad network.
ha.off: House ads are switched off: nothing shows in the journal and nothing is counted. Switch them on in the card “House ads in the journal”.
ha.listEmptyText: Press “New ad” to make the first one. A new ad starts switched off.
ha.report: Clicks and orders, by ad and place
ha.reportSub: Orders placed within {n} days after a click count for the ad clicked last. Sales are delivered orders only.
ha.noMoney: You can see clicks and order counts. Amounts need the reports permission.
ha.reportEmpty: No place has been clicked in this period.
ha.cardText: Off: no house ad shows anywhere. On: each ad shows in its places, within its dates, by weight, the most relevant first.
ha.maxPerPage: Ads on one article page, at most
ha.inlineMax: Of them inside the words, at most
ha.popupScrollPct: A new popup opens after reading
ha.capTimes: A new popup shows at most
ha.searchGuard: Popup on a searcher’s first phone screen
ha.countViews: Count how often each ad is seen
ha.creditDays: An order counts for a click within
ha.readOnly: You can see the ads. Changing them needs the publish permission.
ha.how1: Make an ad: what it shows (a banner picture, a product, a combo or a category), its words in English and Bengali, its dates and weight.
ha.how2: Give it places: the journal’s top, between cards, a topic page, inside an article after paragraph N, beside an article on a wide screen, at the end, a slim bar or a popup.
ha.how3: Switch the ad and its places on. The most relevant ad wins a place (one article, then its topic, then a product it shows, then all); equal ones share by weight.
ha.how4: Every page keeps the rules: at most the set number of ads on an article, none before the first paragraph, never the same ad twice, no popup on a searcher’s first phone screen.

e.sub: What the ad shows, its words and dates; then where it shows.
e.name: Name (only you see it)
e.targetHint: For example /collections/polo — always one of the shop’s own pages.
e.pictureHint: From the media library. A banner needs one; a product ad uses the product’s photo when none is chosen.
e.weightHint: When several ads fit a place equally, a higher weight shows more often.
e.datesHint: Whole shop days. Leave empty for no limit.
e.bnHint: Empty: the English words show on the Bengali pages.
e.created: Ad made — switched off. Now give it a place.
e.failed: Could not save. Check the fields marked and try again.
e.label: {shop} offer
e.placesSub: Where this ad shows. A new place starts switched off.
e.noPlaces: No place yet. Add one below.
e.saveFirst: Save the ad first; then add its places.
e.readOnly: You can see this ad. Changing it needs the publish permission.
